no_bid_reason: Visakoivu Oy meets six of the seven eligibility requirements in Section 3 (M001-M006), but fails M007: clause 3.7 requires at least one reference project with a contract value of at least EUR 2,000,000 within the last five years, and the tenderer's largest reference project on file (REF02, Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue, kiinteistonhoidon ja LVI-ylapidon puitesopimus) is valued at EUR 1,650,000, which falls short of that threshold. Section 3 states that failure to meet any one eligibility requirement excludes the tenderer regardless of technical or commercial merit, so this is a genuine no-bid, not a curable gap. The technical, commercial, form, and format rows of the requirement matrix have deliberately not been drafted, since Visakoivu Oy will not be submitting a tender for this procurement; the unanswered rows are: M008, M009, M010, M011, M012, M013, M014, M015, M016, M017, M018, M019, M020, M021, M022, M023, M024, M025, M026, M027, M028, M029, M030, M031, M032, M033, M034, M035, M036, M037, M038, M039, M040, M041, M042, M043, M044, M045, M046, M047, M048, M049, M050, M051, M052, M053.
